findings: The A100 shared physical system is reconstructed from its checked primary residual support. Descriptor basis_indices maps local polynomial positions to raw E1 indices; no raw/local index substitution is used implicitly.

Every selected denominator relation is replayed as a rational sum of the original shared-numerator equations multiplied by constants or linear denominator monomials. All numerator-containing monomials cancel in the claimed result.

The 52 additional relations are independent modulo the finite span of constant and linear multiples of the baseline. This is not an assertion of nonmembership in the full baseline ideal or radical, or completeness of the projected ideal.

Mixed-degree maps use degree minus each generator degree; every column has the requested total degree. Rational and modular ranks, independent relations, and exact coordinate-power products are checked.
Five power identities force four raw coefficients 56,123,210,229 to vanish. The duplicate degree-four power of 56 is not a fifth distinct removed coordinate.

The thirteen-direction residual reduces to nine by those powers, to seven by rebuilt necessities removing raw180,232, and to five after checked charts for raw6 and211. All seven two-character chart pivots are retained; the other five failed attempts remain visible.

The final raw support 42,88,102,111,114 is a subspace of the full thirteen-direction X0/X1 pair. The checker explicitly replays that full pair and its single-character closure rather than invoking an unbound smaller support.
Partial chart prefixes cannot remove coordinates unless the complete prescribed chart cover and explicit removed list are checked. A valid timeout prefix does not claim the unfinished exclusion.
A review finding that block/closure bounds were only telemetry was resolved by the author: phase plans, source hashes, 180-second bounds, statuses, exits, and completion consistency are now verified.
The original prospective125 and primary131 checkpoints remain separate from this supplemental exclusion. The continuation does not change the high-versus-low ranking outcome.

isolated_checker_exercises.method: Copies of packets and matching timeout receipts were substituted only in process memory. Report writes were intercepted. No proof packet or stored validation receipt was changed by these exercises.

limits: Both physical reconstructions share identity and graded-map utilities. No independent human review, complete free resolution, Lean proof, or holdout solution is asserted.
